chemical_active_ingredient: Captan 50% WP or Difenoconazole 25% EC
safety_precautions: Wear full PPE with nitrile gloves and respirator mask. Avoid application during bloom stage to protect honeybees and pollinators.

organic_remedy: Copper octanoate / Bordeaux mixture 1% / Trichoderma harzianum
chemical_active_ingredient: Thiophanate-methyl 70% WP or Captan 50% WP
safety_precautions: Prune mummified fruit and dead wood in winter. Avoid spray drift into ponds and aquatic habitats.

organic_remedy: Liquid copper fungicide / Elemental sulfur spray
chemical_active_ingredient: Myclobutanil 20% WP or Mancozeb 75% WP
safety_precautions: Eradicate nearby eastern red cedar and juniper alternate hosts within 1-2 miles where feasible.

organic_remedy: Preventive compost tea / balanced organic mulch / foliar kelp
chemical_active_ingredient: None (maintain balanced tree nutrition program)
safety_precautions: Routine orchard scouting. Maintain open canopy pruning for air circulation and light penetration.

organic_remedy: Pine bark mulch / elemental sulfur for pH 4.5-5.2 / drip irrigation
chemical_active_ingredient: None (maintain soil acidity and drip fertigation)
safety_precautions: Soil pH testing twice yearly. Avoid overhead irrigation to prevent foliar disease.

organic_remedy: Potassium bicarbonate / Cold-pressed Neem oil 0.5% / Sulfur 80% WDG
chemical_active_ingredient: Tebuconazole 25.9% EC or Trifloxystrobin 50% WG
safety_precautions: Do not apply sulfur when temperatures exceed 32°C (89°F) to prevent phytotoxic foliar burn.

organic_remedy: Dormant horticultural oil spray during winter / well-rotted compost
chemical_active_ingredient: None (standard orchard sanitation and pruning)
safety_precautions: Annual dormant pruning. Monitor for fruit flies

organic_remedy: Bacillus amyloliquefaciens foliar spray / bio-fungicide
chemical_active_ingredient: Azoxystrobin + Propiconazole (Quilt Xcel) or Pyraclostrobin 250 EC
safety_precautions: Rotate crops out of corn for 1-2 years. Incorporate crop residues in high-risk conservation tillage fields.

organic_remedy: Liquid copper octanoate / compost extract bio-spray
chemical_active_ingredient: Mancozeb 75% WP or Pyraclostrobin 20% WG
safety_precautions: Apply at first sign of pustules on upper canopy. Do not feed treated forage to dairy animals before PHI.

organic_remedy: Trichoderma viride seed treatment / Bacillus subtilis foliar spray
chemical_active_ingredient: Propiconazole 25% EC or Azoxystrobin 23% SC
safety_precautions: Avoid continuous corn-on-corn monoculture. Wear protective eyewear

organic_remedy: Green manure cover cropping / mycorrhizal root inoculant
chemical_active_ingredient: None (balanced nitrogen and potassium management)
safety_precautions: Regular field scouting during vegetative V6 to reproductive R1 silking stages.

organic_remedy: Copper hydroxide 53.8% WG / Lime sulfur dormant spray
chemical_active_ingredient: Mancozeb 75% WP or Myclobutanil 20% WP
safety_precautions: Remove mummified berries and infected canes during winter pruning. Observe strict pre-harvest intervals for wine grapes.

organic_remedy: Pruning wound sealants with Trichoderma atroviride / vine rejuvenation
chemical_active_ingredient: Thiophanate-methyl paste (pruning wounds) or Fosetyl-Aluminium 80% WP
safety_precautions: Prune only in dry weather. Disinfect pruning shears between individual vines using 70% isopropyl alcohol.

organic_remedy: Bordeaux mixture 1% / Copper oxychloride 50% WP
chemical_active_ingredient: Difenoconazole 25% EC or Mancozeb 75% WP
safety_precautions: Ensure thorough coverage of under-leaf surfaces. Avoid excessive copper accumulation in vineyard soil.

organic_remedy: Canopy leaf thinning for sunlight exposure / balanced compost
chemical_active_ingredient: None (balanced grapevine trellising and canopy airflow)
safety_precautions: Shoot thinning and leaf pulling in the fruiting zone to maximize airflow and minimize humidity.

organic_remedy: Horticultural mineral oil 1% / Kaolin clay barrier / Tamarixia radiata parasitoids
chemical_active_ingredient: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL or Thiamethoxam 25% WG (vector control) + Zn/Mn/Fe foliar nutrition
safety_precautions: Eradicate symptomatic trees in non-endemic zones. Do not spray systemic neonicotinoids during bloom to protect bees.

organic_remedy: Copper hydroxide 53.8% WG / Bacillus subtilis strain QST 713
chemical_active_ingredient: Copper octanoate or Dodine 65% WP
safety_precautions: Use reduced copper rates post-shuck split to avoid fruit marking and phytotoxic leaf shot-holing.

organic_remedy: Dormant copper spray for peach leaf curl / superior horticultural oil
chemical_active_ingredient: None (preventive orchard sanitation)
safety_precautions: Prune trees to an open-center vase system for maximum interior sunlight and rapid leaf drying.

organic_remedy: Copper hydroxide 53.8% WG + Bacillus amyloliquefaciens
chemical_active_ingredient: Fixed Copper + Mancozeb 75% WP synergistic tank mix
safety_precautions: Do not work in fields when foliage is wet. Disinfect field crates

organic_remedy: Drip fertigation / silver reflective mulch against aphid/thrips vectors
chemical_active_ingredient: None (balanced fertility and uniform soil moisture)
safety_precautions: Maintain consistent soil calcium and moisture to eliminate blossom end rot susceptibility.

organic_remedy: Copper oxychloride 50% WP / Bacillus subtilis / Potassium phosphite
chemical_active_ingredient: Azoxystrobin 23% SC or Chlorothalonil 75% WP
safety_precautions: Rotate FRAC group 11 (strobilurin) with FRAC group M5 (chlorothalonil) to prevent fungal resistance.

organic_remedy: Copper sulfate (Bordeaux mixture 1%) / Copper hydroxide / Trichoderma harzianum
chemical_active_ingredient: Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) or Mandipropamid 23.4% SC or Cymoxanil 60% WG
safety_precautions: Immediate mandatory treatment upon regional blight forecasts. Destroy volunteer potatoes and cull piles completely.

organic_remedy: Certified disease-free seed tubers / bio-fertilizer inoculation
chemical_active_ingredient: None (standard hilling and irrigation management)
safety_precautions: Proper hill formation to prevent tuber exposure to greening and down-washing blight zoospores.

organic_remedy: Trellising for cane aeration / organic straw mulch / drip lines
chemical_active_ingredient: None (sanitation and removal of spent floricanes)
safety_precautions: Prune out and burn spent 2-year-old floricanes immediately following summer harvest.

organic_remedy: Bradyrhizobium japonicum seed inoculant / crop rotation with corn
chemical_active_ingredient: None (weed management and balanced potash fertility)
safety_precautions: Maintain clean field borders. Scout regularly for stink bugs

organic_remedy: Potassium bicarbonate (3g/L) / Horticultural oil 1% / Sulfur 80% WDG / Milk dilution 10%
chemical_active_ingredient: Myclobutanil 20% WP or Quinoxyfen 250 SC or Triflumizole 50% WP
safety_precautions: Ensure thorough under-leaf coverage. Avoid sulfur applications when ambient temperature exceeds 32°C.

organic_remedy: Copper octanoate / Bacillus subtilis foliar spray / bio-fungicide
chemical_active_ingredient: Captan 50% WP or Thiophanate-methyl 70% WP
safety_precautions: Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation. Renovate and mow matted row strawberry beds after final spring harvest.

organic_remedy: Clean straw mulch / drip fertigation / predatory mite release
chemical_active_ingredient: None (optimum crown depth planting and bed aeration)
safety_precautions: Plant crowns level with the soil line (never buried). Maintain good field drainage to prevent crown rot.

organic_remedy: Copper hydroxide 53.8% WG + Bacillus amyloliquefaciens strain D747
chemical_active_ingredient: Copper hydroxide + Mancozeb 75% WP tank mix or Actigard (Acibenzolar-S-methyl)
safety_precautions: Never work in fields when tomato plants are wet. Sanitize tomato stakes

organic_remedy: Copper octanoate / Potassium bicarbonate / Bacillus subtilis / Serenade ASO
chemical_active_ingredient: Chlorothalonil 75% WP or Azoxystrobin 23% SC or Difenoconazole 25% EC
safety_precautions: Strip lower 12 inches of foliage to eliminate soil-splash contact. Rotate fungicide chemistries (FRAC M5 with FRAC 11/3).

organic_remedy: Copper hydroxide (2.5g/L) / Bordeaux mixture 1% / Potassium phosphonate salts
chemical_active_ingredient: Mandipropamid 23.4% SC (Revus) or Cyazofamid 34.5% SC (Ranman) or Cymoxanil 60% WG
safety_precautions: Highly destructive pathogen. Rogue and bag infected plants immediately in plastic bags; never compost infected tomato tissue.

organic_remedy: Copper sulfate / Potassium bicarbonate / high-tunnel exhaust ventilation
chemical_active_ingredient: Difenoconazole 25% EC or Chlorothalonil 75% WP
safety_precautions: Maintain greenhouse and high tunnel relative humidity strictly below 85%. Increase plant spacing for airflow.

organic_remedy: Copper hydroxide 53.8% WG / Cold-pressed Neem oil / Bio-fungicide foliar drench
chemical_active_ingredient: Chlorothalonil 75% WP or Mancozeb 75% WP
safety_precautions: Apply heavy organic or plastic mulch to suppress spore splash from soil. Prune infected lower leaves promptly.

organic_remedy: Insecticidal soap / Neem oil 0.5% / Predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis)
chemical_active_ingredient: Abamectin 1.8% EC or Spiromesifen 22.9% SC or Bifenazate 43.2% SC
safety_precautions: Target spray at underside of leaves where mite colonies feed. Rotate miticide modes of action to prevent resistance.

organic_remedy: Liquid copper fungicide / Bacillus amyloliquefaciens
chemical_active_ingredient: Boscalid + Pyraclostrobin (Pristine WG) or Fluxapyroxad + Difenoconazole
safety_precautions: Maintain balanced potassium nutrition. Clear and bury all post-harvest crop residue immediately.

organic_remedy: Yellow sticky card traps / Insecticidal soap / Silver reflective mulch / Encarsia formosa
chemical_active_ingredient: Thiamethoxam 25% WG or Acetamiprid 20% SP or Spirotetramat 150 OD (vector control)
safety_precautions: No chemical cure for viral infection. Rogue infected plants in sealed bags to trap vectoring whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci).

chemical_active_ingredient: None (viral pathogen - no chemical viricide; strictly sanitation and genetic resistance)
safety_precautions: Prohibit tobacco use near greenhouses. Wash hands with soap and water before handling plants. Plant Tm-2^2 resistant varieties.
